description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for Fixed Deposit Products in the Fineract project, including request/response schemas and nested data models.

classes.name: FixedDepositProductsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains Swagger schema definitions for Fixed Deposit Product API requests and responses.

classes.name: PostFixedDepositProductsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new fixed deposit product.

classes.name: PostFixedDepositProductsCharts
classes.description: Nested schema for deposit charts within create request.

classes.name: PostFixedDepositProductsChartSlabs
classes.description: Schema for individual chart slabs within deposit charts.

classes.name: PostFixedDepositProductsResponse
classes.description: Response schema for fixed deposit product creation, returning resource ID.

classes.name: PutFixedDepositProductsProductIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating fixed deposit product details.

classes.name: PutFixedDepositProductsProductIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema for updates showing resource ID and changes.

classes.name: GetFixedDepositProductsResponse
classes.description: Detailed schema for fixed deposit product details, including nested sub-schemas for currency, deposit terms, interest, accounting, etc.

classes.name: GetFixedDepositProductsProductIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for specific fixed deposit product by ID, including detailed nested schemas for accounts and interest periods.

classes.name: DeleteFixedDepositProductsProductIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema for deleting a fixed deposit product by ID.
